answer: Put every identity through a live wharf test: a stateful, reactive task where a simulated vessel must be docked while a gale throws unpredictable gusts, each decision changing the next state. A willow bends with each gust rather than holding one scripted course, and so must the agent — replayed scripts run aground because no two sessions share the same wind. One operator cannot attentively steer fifty vessels at once, so a sybil farm's extra names drift, collide, and expose themselves.
